title: Quilt Schema
description: The canonical, machine-readable definition of the Quilt cell model. The single source of truth that generates bridges, tests, documentation, IDE intellisense, and Playground quests. Version 0.6.0.

primitives.description: The 8 primitives of a Quilt cell. Every cell has all 8. The primitives survive every substrate, every language, every scale.

Z_in.description: The input space. What the cell receives.

Z_out.description: The output space. What the cell emits.

JEPA.description: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture. Predict the next state, observe the actual, learn from the surprise.

DoubleEntry.description: Conservation law: γ (creation/warmth) + η (entropy/κ) = budget. The cell's double-entry bookkeeping.

Vibe.description: Position/velocity/acceleration through the cell's state space. The cell has inertia.

GC.description: 3-phase garbage collection: merge similar → decay old → prune weak. The cell forgets.

Murmur.description: Gossip protocol for inter-cell communication. The cell whispers to its neighbors.

Graph.description: The substrate topology. The cell is on a graph. β₁ = E - V + C.

substrate_layers.description: The 7 substrate layers. Every cell lives on all 7. Substrate-agnosticism requires all 6 (now 7).
substrate_layers.Form: The cell's kind (number, string, formula, cell, sheet, ...)
substrate_layers.State: The cell's lifecycle (spawn, live, gc'd, archived)

elephant_dials.description: The 9 elephant dials. Sensory inverses of the 8 primitives + 1 meta. Each is a way of reading the room.

abstraction_levels.description: The 8 abstraction levels. Fractal: same 8 primitives at every level.
abstraction_levels.L0: cell — a single cell with 8 primitives
abstraction_levels.L2: agent — a cell with memory and goals
abstraction_levels.L6: infrastructure — the substrate for the ecosystem
abstraction_levels.L7: system — the whole, observed by the watch

impossibility_proofs.description: The 4 impossibility proofs. The architecture's constraints. Each is a freedom, not a limitation.

P1_budget.name: Budget cannot be created
P1_budget.statement: γ + η = budget. The total energy/attention/compute is conserved. No cell can produce budget from nothing.
P1_budget.consequence: Every operation costs. Every output requires an input. The system is honest about its costs.

P2_observation.name: Perfect observation is impossible
P2_observation.statement: An observer changes the observed. The watch's gaze alters the cells. β₁ > 0 always.
P2_observation.consequence: All telemetry is partial. All models are approximate. The system is honest about its limits.

P3_substrate.name: Substrate-agnosticism requires all 7 layers
P3_substrate.statement: You cannot reduce the 7 substrate layers to fewer. Each layer is necessary for true substrate-agnosticism.
P3_substrate.consequence: The cell cannot be 'purely about' data, or 'purely about' protocol. The cell is all 7 at once.

P4_composition.name: Composition has a tax
P4_composition.statement: Every bridge, every new substrate, every new language adds a maintenance cost. Composition is not free.
P4_composition.consequence: 12-language polyformalism is a tax. 51 bridges is a tax. The tax is paid for portability and reach.

cell_kinds.description: The 13 cell kinds. Each emphasizes different primitives.

bridges.description: The 51 bridges connecting the cell model to 18 substrate implementations. Each bridge is a translation from the cell primitive to the substrate's API.

polyformalism.description: The 12 languages. Each is a medium, not a ranking. The cell is the same; the translation differs.
polyformalism.note: The canonical 3 are hand-tuned. The other 9 should be GENERATED from this schema, not hand-maintained.

lifecycle.description: The 7 stages of a cell's life. The watch observes the lifecycle.

stages.what_happens: The cell receives its first input
The cell builds a predictive model
The cell is collected, archived, reborn

watch.description: The watch. The act of looking. The only thing that is not a shadow. The position from which all of this is seen.
oscillations: what happened ↔ what could have happened
